sensible_stackables.config.items.desc: Edit stack sizes for items and item tags here.
sensible_stackables.config.uncapStackSiz: Removes the max stack size hard limit of 99.
sensible_stackables.config.commonStackSi: Changes the max stack size of all items which use the default max stack size of 64. This setting is limited to 99 unless "Uncap stack size" is enabled.
sensible_stackables.client_config.itemCo: If a stack has more than 999 items, shortens the displayed item count (for example 1000 -> 1K, 1000000 -> 1M).
If the displayed item count has more than 2 characters (for example 999), reduces the size of the displayed item count to prevent text overlapping.
If a stack has more than 999 items and "Shorten item count" is enabled, shows the exact item count in the item tooltip.
